meaning: Heat pump internal heater fault. Bosch uses this same sentence for E09.
diySteps: Reset power at the breaker for 30 seconds, then turn it back on
If E20 is still there, call Bosch Customer Support at 1-800-944-2904 with the model number
proAdvice: E20 and E09 are written the same way on Bosch's list. Neither one is E12. E12 is limescale and uses a descaler. E21 is a blocked heat pump, which is a different sentence.
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
